more_info.banned_in:
Approved in the EU.
Approved in the US.
US food use is subject to the listed CFR provisions and their conditions, checked in 2026.
more_info.overview: Sulphuric acid is used as a flavour enhancer in food. Its technological role is to strengthen flavours already present in food.
more_info.side_effects:
Assessed food exposure raised no concern.
Higher-dose human sulphate intake can cause laxative effects.
